notablePrerequisites: Phantom Nomad does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Phantom Nomad persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantom Nomad, adding {C}{C}.
When Phantom Nomad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its first ability.
Repeat.
